lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Goojaree, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੀ ਚਨਣਾਠੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਉਰਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa naam karee chananaatheeaa je man urasaa hoi ||
lines.translation: I would make Your Name the sandalwood, and my mind the stone to rub it on;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਜੇ ਰਲੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: karanee ku(n)goo je ralai ghat a(n)tar poojaa hoi ||1||
lines.translation: for saffron, I would offer good deeds; thus, I perform worship and adoration within my heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: poojaa keechai naam dhiaaeeai bin naavai pooj na hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Perform worship and adoration by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Name, there is no worship and adoration. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੇਵ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar dev pakhaaleeahi je man dhovai koi ||
lines.translation: If one were to wash his heart inwardly, like the stone idol which is washed on the outside,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਜੀਉ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਮੋਖ ਪਇਆਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jooth lahai jeeu maajeeai mokh paiaanaa hoi ||2||
lines.translation: his filth would be removed, his soul would be cleansed, and he would be liberated when he departs. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਖੜੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pasoo milahi cha(n)giaaeeaa khaR khaavahi a(n)mrit dehi ||
lines.translation: Even beasts have value, as they eat grass and give milk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam vihoone aadamee dhrig jeevan karam karehi ||3||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the mortal's life is cursed, as are the actions he performs. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇੜਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: neRaa hai door na jaaniahu nit saare sa(n)mhaale ||
lines.translation: The Lord is hear at hand - do not think that He is far away. He always cherishes us, and remembers us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo devai so khaavanaa kahu naanak saachaa he ||4||1||
lines.translation: Whatever He gives us, we eat; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਪਜੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naabh kamal te brahamaa upaje bed paRahi mukh ka(n)th savaar ||
lines.translation: From the lotus of Vishnu's navel, Brahma was born; He chanted the Vedas with a melodious voice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਣਾ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa ko a(n)t na jaaee lakhanaa aavat jaat rahai gubaar ||1||
lines.translation: He could not find the Lord's limits, and he remained in the darkness of coming and going. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: preetam kiu bisarahi mere praan adhaar ||
lines.translation: Why should I forget my Beloved? He is the support of my very breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee bhagat karahi jan poore mun jan sevahi gur veechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The perfect beings perform devotional worship to Him. The silent sages serve Him through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: rav sas deepak jaa ke tribhavan ekaa jot muraar ||
lines.translation: His lamps are the sun and the moon; the One Light of the Destroyer of ego fills the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hoi s ahinis niramal manamukh rain a(n)dhaar ||2||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh remains immaculately pure, day and night, while the self-willed manmukh is enveloped by the darkness of night. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਾ ਦੁਹੁ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਿਆ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh samaadh karahi nit jhagaraa duhu lochan kiaa herai ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi are continually in conflict; what can they see with their two eyes?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar jot sabad dhun jaagai satigur jhagar niberai ||3||
lines.translation: One who has the Divine Light within his heart, and is awakened to the melody of the Word of the Shabad - the True Guru settles his conflicts. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar naath bea(n)t ajonee saachai mahal apaaraa ||
lines.translation: O Lord of angels and men, infinite and unborn, Your True Mansion is incomparable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sahaj mile jagajeevan nadar karahu nisataaraa ||4||2||
lines.translation: Nanak merges imperceptibly into the Life of the world; shower Your mercy upon him, and save him. ||4||2||
